module: Node "EndScreen Lap Times" (repeat_instant, color ui). Displays a vehicle's lap times on the end screen. Inputs: flow, race (race data table containing states[vehId]), vehId (number, vehicle; defaults to the player vehicle 0). Output: flow (chainFlow).
notes: If vehId is given but matches no object, or if race.states has no entry for this vehicle, addLaptimesForVehicle receives nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Finds the vehicle (scenetree.findObjectById(vehId) or getPlayerVehicle(0)) then, if race is provided, adds the laps of race.states[veh:getID()] via modules.ui:addLaptimesForVehicle.
